steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Excessive Violence
steps: This character may only choose this attack if it has a |<loaded>Loaded| token.
During the |*Pay| |!power| |*Cost| step of this attack, this character loses all Loaded tokens it has.
Before |!damage| is dealt, all other characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 2 |!damage|.

After this attack is resolved, this character is Thrown Away from the defender |!range_small|. This Throw is resolved by the player controlling the defender. Then, if this character does not have a Dazed token, it suffers 3 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Hydra Tactics
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 2 of this character. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character.

superPowers.name: Muy Caliente
superPowers.body: This character gains one |<loaded>Loaded| token at the start of the Game.

superPowers.name: But HOW!?
superPowers.body: If this character does not have an Activated token and would be KO'd by having damage tokens placed on it, it gains a Dazed token instead. During the |*Cleanup Phase|, when you would normally flip this character's card as a result of a Dazed token, it remains on its Injured side and this character loses 3 |!power|.|\|If, at any time, this is the only character you control, you lose the Game.
